meeting_point: Marina Del Ray Boat Rental - Located on the dock behind El Torito
location_address: 13717 Fiji Way Marina del Rey, CA US 90292
description:
Our smallest power boat in our fleet makes up for its size in big fun and ease of use, perfect for a couple and/or a couple and two small children. This boat is very easy for the novice to learn how to operate a powerboat for the first time. Comes with comfortable swiveling seats and a bimini top to protect you from sun.

The 13ft. Boston Whaler is only allowed inside the harbor, if you want to explore outside the harbor please see our 17ft. Boston Whaler or 21ft. Grady White.

If you would like to reserve more than one boat at a time, please give us a call.
what_is_included:
###Vessel Details:
- Model Name: 130 Super Sport
- 3 persons or 500 lbs maximum limit. 
- Due to its small size, this vessel is only allowed inside the harbor.
- 40 hp motor
- No fishing allowed in this vessel.
- Fuel included in price
disclaimers:
- A $300 damage deposit is required on the day of rental. Visa or MasterCard only, NO CASH, NO DEBIT CARD, NO AMEX accepted for damage deposit.
- A 2-hour minimum rental is required on weekends from May 1–October 31.
- We reserve the right to increase the minimum rental period during busy times (most holidays, weekends, and busy weekdays) as well as those times when we are short-staffed.
- A 50% deposit is required at the time of reservation on rentals of 3 or more hours.
- A 7-day notice is required for any changes or cancellation to the reservation of 3 or more hours, or you will forfeit your 50% rental deposit.
- A 24-hour notice is required for any changes or cancellation to the reservation of less than 3 hours. If 24-hour notice is not given to reservations of less than 3 hours, you will be charged 50% of the rental price
